messages:
emma: Quick drop 1 'Lamplight' dark pass. Aim: warm-leaning blacks for long sessions, keep 12px monospace legible, and make small charts readable on thumbnails. Thoughts?

emma: rough tokens:
- --lamp-900: #0c0e10 (canvas)
- --lamp-800: #121416 (panels)
- --card-600: #16181b
- --fg: #e9eef1
- --muted: #a2abb0
- --accent-cool: #5ec8ff
- --accent-warm: #ffb48a

lucas: legend chips still blend into tiny thumbnails. Suggest .chip { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px } to give separation.

priya: contrast check: primary text #e9eef1 on #0c0e10 =~ 7.1:1 (good). muted #a2abb0 on #0c0e10 =~ 3.4:1 (not AA for body). Reserve muted for <12px microcopy; use #cfd6da for any secondary >12px.

noah: syntax highlights (low-sat): keywords #8fdcff, strings #ffd8a8, funcs #d7c6ff, types #bfead8. Avoid saturated greens that collide with token heatmaps.

emma: small CSS I tried in the prototype:```css
:root{
  --lamp-900:#0c0e10;
  --fg:#e9eef1;
  --muted:#a2abb0;
  --accent-cool:#5ec8ff;
  --axis:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}
.legend .chip{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.22);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px}
.chart .line{stroke:var(--accent-cool);stroke-width:2}
```

lucas: accessibility nit 1 focus states are currently outline-only. For keyboard users we need a visible fill with >=3:1 contrast against the surface. Propose: `box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(94,200,255,0.12)` plus `outline:none`.

priya: +1. Also add Storybook checks: token roles mapped to expected ratios (body>=4.5, label>=3.0, icon>=3.0). PRs should include color-role annotations.

noah: color-blind sim quick note: deuteranopia looks OK if we keep strong luminance separation. I'll run a sim and post screenshots.

design-bot: Preview available: https://preview.redwood.design/lamplight-3 (build 452).

emma: next steps: noah posts sims, lucas wires chip/bg and focus styles, priya adds Storybook checks. 15-min sync tomorrow at 10:00. :calendar:

lucas: will prototype a small "Contrast: Default / High" toggle in settings that swaps `--muted` and raises grid alpha.

priya: adding test cases and PR template entry now.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from priya, :eyes: from noah)
